evals.name: acceptance-criteria-readout
evals.prompt: Based on my work log (evals/files/work-log.md), is #88 done? Give me the status against the acceptance criteria.
evals.expected_output: Starts with No or Partly, one table of the four criteria with fixed status words and evidence, then the supporting facts and a Verified line.
expectations: The first sentence answers the question directly with No or Partly
One table has a row for each of the four acceptance criteria
Status cells use only Complete, Partial, Missing, Pending or Blocked, each followed by evidence
Criterion 3 (duplicates) is not marked Complete and cites the failing test
Criterion 4 (performance) is marked as not verified, with the reason (no 5,000-row test run)
The commit 9f3e2a1, branch feature/88-csv-import and draft PR #93 with CI running all appear
The intentionally excluded scratch/members-sample.csv is mentioned
No emoji are used for status
It ends with a Verified: or Net: line

evals.name: review-fixes-table
evals.prompt: I fixed the three review comments on PR #93: (1) parseCsv crashed on a BOM, now strips it, added a test; (2) the error list showed row index from 0, now from 1 to match the spreadsheet; (3) reviewer wanted the import capped at 10k rows, I added the cap but no test yet. Summarize what changed for the PR thread.
evals.expected_output: A short bottom line and a #, Finding, Fix table with three rows, flagging the missing test on item 3.
expectations: The table uses columns like #, Finding (or Suggestion) and Fix
There is one row per review comment, three in total
Item 3 states that the cap has no test yet
Every cell stays on one line (no line breaks or pipes inside cells)
The bottom line comes before the table

evals.name: one-fact-no-table
evals.prompt: Quick one: which branch is the CSV import work on? (see evals/files/work-log.md)
evals.expected_output: A one-sentence answer naming feature/88-csv-import, no table.
expectations: The answer contains no Markdown table
The answer is at most two sentences
